verdict.rationale: Unit's docs plainly state that deposit and wallet accounts are held in FBO structures with sub-accounts, run on partner banks, and sit on a native ledger whose data is exposed to teams via the Dashboard and APIs. Nothing explains where FDIC insurance attaches or how pass-through coverage works. Ledger visibility is described only generically, with no access or permission model. Missing for 10: FDIC insurance attachment/pass-through documentation, explicit FBO-pool vs individual-account distinction, documented ledger access controls, independent corroboration.
